title: Efficient Expert-Parallel Communication on PCIe-Connected Consumer GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2609.40093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Expert parallelism (EP) enables inference of large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models by placing their experts across multiple GPUs, but requires substantial communication between GPUs at every MoE layer. As contemporary MoE models activate more experts per token, this communication accounts for a growing fraction of inference time. The cost becomes particularly pronounced on PCIe-based consumer GPU systems, where all inter-GPU transfers traverse CPU memory. However, existing MoE-specialized EP communication libraries assume that direct GPU-to-GPU access is available, largely overlooking consumer GPUs. Therefore, most LLM frameworks instead rely on NCCL, whose CPU-staged communication incurs redundant PCIe transfers and competes with expert computation for GPU resources, limiting their overlap. translated_title: 面向PCIe互联消费级GPU的高效专家并行通信
translated_abstract: 专家并行通过将大规模混合专家模型的专家放置在多个GPU上，从而实现MoE模型的推理，但这需要在每个MoE层进行GPU间的大量通信。随着当代MoE模型每个token激活更多专家，这种通信占推理时间的比例越来越大。在基于PCIe的消费级GPU系统上，这一成本尤为显著，因为所有GPU间传输都必须经过CPU内存。然而，现有的MoE专用EP通信库都假设可以直接进行GPU到GPU的访问，在很大程度上忽视了消费级GPU。因此，大多数LLM框架转而依赖NCCL，而NCCL基于CPU中转的通信方式会产生冗余的PCIe传输，并与专家计算争夺GPU资源，限制了通信与计算的重叠。我们提出了ThunderEP，这是一种针对此类系统的新型通信设计，它消除了传统环形算法的中继跳数，通过更高效的路径移动数据……
tldr: 提出ThunderEP，一种面向PCIe互联消费级GPU的MoE专家并行通信设计，通过消除传统环形算法的中继跳数来减少冗余PCIe传输并改善通信与计算的重叠。
en_tdlr: ThunderEP, a novel expert-parallel communication design for PCIe-connected consumer GPUs that removes the relay hops of traditional ring algorithms to reduce redundant PCIe transfers and improve communication-computation overlap.
